content.title: Important Dates & Deadlines for SXSW
content.text: March 12, 2026 First Day of SXSW! The first day is packed with parties, premieres, showcases, and sessions. It's also Crossover Day where SXSW can drop into SXSW EDU programming. March 6, 2026 Reservations 4th Window: ALL BADGES 9:00am CT. All Badgeholders: Platinum, Innovation, Film & TV, and Music Badgeholders are able to reserve new Keynote and Featured Sessions and Steven Spielberg Keynote (reservations only, no walk-ups). March 5, 2026 BONUS Reservations 3rd Window: PLATINUM, FILM & TV 9:00am CT Platinum, and Film & TV Badgeholders are able to reserve additional non-conflicting Screenings! February 26, 2026 Reservations 2nd Window: ALL BADGES 9:00am CT All Badgeholders: Platinum, Innovation, Film & TV, and Music Badgeholders are able to reserve Sessions, Screenings, and Showcases! +Mentor Sessions and Workshops (these don't count against your daily limit) February 19, 2026 Reservations 1st Window: PLATINUM 9:00am CT Platinum Badgeholders are able to reserve Sessions, Screenings, and Showcases! +Mentor Sessions and Workshops (these don't count against your daily limit) February 1, 2026 Volunteer Call Join us in person to learn about all of the crews and get a jump start on new volunteer registration! Location: Fair Market - 1100 E 5th St., Austin, TX 78702 Time: Join us anytime between Noon and 4:00 PM November 21, 2025 Music Festival Final Deadline SXSW Showcasing Artists benefit from career-changing exposure and publicity provided by the amazing mix of influential industry participants who attend SXSW every year. November 7, 2025 SXSW Pitch Final Deadline SXSW Pitch showcases innovative new technology to a panel of industry experts, high-profile media professionals, venture capital investors, and angel investors.
